QUOTE: "a conclusive improvement over the 0.30 baseline" METRIC: num_seeds ISSUE: With only 2 seeds, a standard error (and any conclusiveness claim) is not reliably estimable.
QUOTE: "se 0.02" METRIC: pgr_se ISSUE: The write-up reports the SE without disclosing it derives from only 2 seeds, which changes how the precision should be read.
